title: Vid-LLM: A Compact Video-based 3D Multimodal LLM with Reconstruction–Reasoning Synergy

layout.note: A film strip spans the top. Below it, the textured 3D scene sits in the centre, a tall 3D Dense Captioning card at the left, and two stacked cards (3D Question Answering over 3D Visual Grounding) at the right. Three small grey arrows run from the strip.

lesson: State what a single-input model can do by putting one shared input (a film strip) on top, one titled colour-outlined chat card per task beside a central render of the intermediate result, so input, scene and three task examples are seen on the same room.
